scope: Concrete independent visual findings during final source-old-new comparison; fixes made by owners/renderer, independently re-viewed afterwards.

issues.finding: Removing decorative beige made fence rails transparent and exposed rear post edges.
issues.resolution: Opaque white rail/post fills restore source occlusion; independently re-viewed in part1_fixes/page_002.jpg.

issues.finding: Fill-only native cogs became pale shapes without required black outlines.
issues.resolution: Owners restored continuous black1pt cog contours retaining tooth counts and marked-tooth positions; independently re-viewed.

issues.finding: Transparent compound artwork exposed rear cap/stalk, roof/chimney and bar/circle lines.
issues.resolution: Opaque white or gray components restore source layering; independently re-viewed final fixed outputs.

issues.finding: Transparent icon anatomy obscured koala, bee/flower and cat feature identity; source lake opacity was lost.
issues.resolution: Opaque anatomical layers, black distinguishing features and opaque gray lakes restored; independently re-viewed final_changed sheets.

issues.finding: Lawn region fill was removed although the question compares grass areas.
issues.resolution: Semantic gray lawn regions restored; independently re-viewed part1_fixes/page_006.jpg.

issues.finding: Matplotlib Patch globalalpha applied fill opacity to black outlines too.
issues.resolution: Renderer now assigns face-only RGBA opacity and keeps black strokes opaque; all three changed PNGs independently re-viewed after central replay.

issues.finding: Face color initials were typed as point-name vertex labels, causing18ptitalic styling.
issues.resolution: All nine labels now16ptregular text anchored at unchanged face centers; independently re-viewed final_changed/page_014.jpg.
